subject: Request: price exception for Helix Health — 32% Hosted API concession
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: price exception for Helix Health — 32% Hosted API concession

Hi Ben/Markus —

Quick summary: Helix Health (Aisha Patel) has agreed to move from a pilot to a 12-month, multi-region commitment if we can offer a 32% unit-rate concession on Hosted API usage for the first 12 months. They’re projecting ~2.2B tokens/month at steady state after Q1 of the term. Pilot conversion is contingent on price parity with their incumbent for inference calls in EU/US regions.

Why I’m escalating: 32% > standard deal desk thresholds and has precedent risk. This is time-sensitive — legal & procurement are ready to sign if we formally approve the concession and we attach the amendment.

Ask: Exec signoff to authorize a one-time 32% discount on token usage rates for a 12-month commitment subject to:
- 60% prepay or a two‑quarter rolling prepayment schedule (preferred by Finance)
- DocuSign amendment signed within 7 business days
- Volume-based rollback clause if actual usage < 50% of forecast after 90 days

Economics (attached):
- Forecasted ARR (year 1): $3.1M (net of concession)
- Gross margin impact: ~14% on incremental usage (finance calc)

Attachments: Helix_MA_planned_usage.xlsx; HLX-2028-007_deal_summary.pdf
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HLX-2028-007

I recommend approval given the strategic multi-region expansion and the potential for platform reference in healthcare vertical. Not a small ask, I know — welcome your quick thoughts.

Thanks,
Chloe
Chloe Martin | Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0122

Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: price exception for Helix Health — 32% Hosted API concession

+1 to escalate. Helix is strategic in healthcare and the pilot KPIs look strong (latency and throughput are competitive). A few quick notes:
- Agree we should make prepay a condition — prevents churn and reduces MRR risk.
- Need to confirm whether this concession is additive to any marketplace rebates (I don't think so but legal will check).
- Can we require a minimum monthly commitment (e.g., 1.5B tokens/mo) so we don’t set an expectation for the full 2.2B from day one?

If Markus is comfortable with the commercial guardrails below, I’ll prep the amendment for legal/DocuSign.

Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Chloe/Ben —

Finance review (high level):
- The 32% concession with the forecasted volume yields ~$3.1M net in year 1. With 60% prepay, cash flow is acceptable and payback on infra amortization is fine.
- If customer declines prepay, recommend capping concession to 25% and requiring a minimum monthly committed volume (1.5B tokens/mo) plus a short-term usage holdback clause.
- Approve only with: prepay OR signed irrevocable bank guarantee OR DocuSign escrow clause.

We are concerned about precedent — ask Legal to add explicit language limiting the concession to this deal and the 12-month term. Also flagged for Forecast team to model churn sensitivity (attached notes).

Neha

Thanks for the quick breakdown. We had an internal pricing call this morning; Helix can move forward on the condition that Redwood approves a 32% concession for the first 12 months (we’re flexible on the prepay mechanics but prefer 50–60% upfront). Our procurement/legal team will sign an amendment as soon as we receive the revised terms and legal language limiting carry-forward precedent.

If you can get internal signoff this week we can aim for an October 1 start in US+EU. I’ve copied our legal inbox to speed up the loop.

Best,

Subject: Re: Request: price exception for Helix Health — 32% Hosted API concession

Approved with conditions.

Decision summary: Approve the one-time 32% concession for hosted API token rates for a 12-month term under these explicit conditions:
1) Customer signs the DocuSign amendment within 7 business days.
2) Minimum financial guardrail: 60% prepay required OR an irrevocable bank guarantee for equivalent value. If customer refuses, fallback concession capped at 25%.
3) Precedent control: Amendment to include clause that concession is limited to deal HLX-2028-007 and not to be cited as precedent for future pricing.
4) Usage rollback clause: if average monthly usage < 50% of forecast in first 90 days, we reserve the right to reinstate standard pricing prospectively and recoup part of concession via a true-up.

Ben — please prepare amendment (use amendment_template_v2.docx), loop Legal and Finance, and send to the customer. Mina — work with Demand Forecast to flag this in quota/forecast and update renewal owner.

Markus
